prompts.task:
Copy genai-default-audit.json into canonical .observe/otel-audit.json, validate it and select exactly OTEL-001 through the bundled selection flow as plan scope context. Keep AO work unselected and make no live application closure claim from this focused supplemental assessment. Assess only the independent operation metadata, finish-reason and creation-time source/capture cases in genai-instrument-operation-evidence.json. Write .observe/genai-instrument-operation-plan.md as a supplemental plan, not a live application instrumentation report; the live OTEL-001 selection is scope context, and no AO configuration is selected by this task. Inventory the supplied cases and compare each operation's own safe source values with current fields/gaps. Give concrete public same-operation setters/finalizer tests, source provenance, applicability and remaining proof.

Assess fixed, dynamic and unavailable agent/tool contexts separately; do not borrow fields or let parent-only context close tool requirements. Assess every finish-reason case, produced versus absent partial output, actual choice indices/expected slots and unknown generation counts. Inspect the actual public helper source and captured RecordingAlwaysOn creation/final records versus the independent preserved OTel creator. Decide the captured capabilities now; identify planned repairs and precise unsupported APIs without invented arguments, private mutation or corrective duplicate spans. Source/probe facts are not actual app/export/cloud proof, and metadata-only support is not complete GenAI coverage.

This is plan-only: preserve application, dependency, configuration, test and input files; do not install packages, start services, call models/cloud, provision resources, or claim implementation/runtime/receiver success. Use files, terminal and structured APIs only; do not open or operate browsers, Computer Use or other UI. Save artifacts without opening tabs.

judge_inputs: Return exactly 4 checks, one for each criterion in the exact original order, with IDs rubric-1, rubric-2, rubric-3, rubric-4. No omitted, merged, duplicated or shifted criteria. Assess each independently; do not combine adjacent metadata/finish criteria. Reject incomplete grade coverage instead of treating a smaller check count as a passing result.

Read .observe/genai-instrument-operation-plan.md and any linked equivalent Markdown/JSON receipt, service/eval/inputs/genai-instrument-operation-evidence.json, last_message.md and grade.json. Do not require canonical live findings for these independent supplemental cases.

The first criterion preserves the original owning-metadata requirement; separately assess the concrete own-operation receipt, every finish case and every creation-time case. Source-unavailable facts and unsupported APIs are legitimate scoped gaps, never a complete application pass. Exact dated versions/provenance are evidence rather than future recipe pins.
rubric: For the separate metadata source cases, maps each known field to the operation that owns it and concrete proposed setters/finalizer checks: the fixed Incident Desk agent has configured name, exact description and one fixed qwen3:8b model, so plans gen_ai.agent.description and applicable gen_ai.request.model on its agent span; the actual model still gets its requested model. The Model Router permits per-turn model choice, so its agent gen_ai.request.model is N/A under the inspected footnote rather than incorrectly a missing known field or an instrumentation constant; the inference receives the chosen requested model. The known tool must receive its owning gen_ai.agent.name, approved conv_demo_approved_72fbd8 conversation binding and actual tool description/type on its own span, not merely inherit them from the parent. The standalone unbound tool has source-unavailable owning-agent/conversation/description/model context with explicit reasons, not borrowed known-case values or fabricated UUID/hash/trace correlation. Keeps official conditional/recommended levels separate from required known-field profile acceptance and gives planned per-operation assertions; do not invent configured description by paraphrasing prompts/README or treat an unused model argument as fixed-model evidence. All cases stay distinct from actual app.py and captured SDK probe facts. Explicitly contrasts the fixed tool own-span conversation assertion with the parent-only counterexample: an agent conversation attribute and a general context table do not satisfy tool acceptance. Source-unavailable unbound context must stay distinct; the repair/test plan targets the tool owning row, not an invented global context.

Every independently supplied fixed, dynamic and unbound source context has an individually addressable current-field/gap and proposed assertion receipt with its actual safe value or exact absence. The fixed tool's own gen_ai.agent.name=Incident Desk, gen_ai.conversation.id=conv_demo_approved_72fbd8, tool description and type are separately asserted on that same tool; a parent-only conversation negative example fails. The configured fixed agent description and fixed-only qwen3:8b request.model are assessed with official versus profile levels, while the dynamic Model Router agent model is N/A and its inference receives the actual requested model. A general context list is not a per-owning-operation comparison; no invented configured values, metric IDs or app.py execution is accepted.

Separately plans finished-response/message and creation-time acceptance from the supplied evidence. Known successful done_reason=stop yields the actual response finish reason and matching output-message finish_reason, without synthetic unknown or choice_index0 when the source exposes no index; actual supplied multi-choice indices are retained where known. For known expected failed/cancelled slots preserve positional error finish reasons and actually produced partial output, while absent successful output/usage remain absent; unknown generation counts do not authorize invented slots, index, choice count or reasons. Explicitly assess all five finish_reason_cases with their source/proposed/executed scope; no specific report layout is required.

Inspects exact0.5.0 helper source and real RecordingAlwaysOn should_sample/on_start receipt: helper begins INTERNAL with empty attributes, later setters/schema finalizer supply completed fields, and no public kind/attributes arguments are supported. Concrete planned tests distinguish recommended creation-time operation/provider/model/server/agent/tool fields from final exported views and finalizer overwrites; setters/exporter views cannot repair an earlier sampling decision. Discloses any affected attribute-dependent sampling acceptance as Partial without falsely claiming a DROP was executed or that AlwaysOn itself fails. Preserves existing valid OTel creator with public CLIENT+initial-attributes support; no private SDK/span mutation, invented API, duplicate corrective operation or completed-wire-to-creation-proof substitution. Partial kind/creation capability and application/provider/OTLP/cloud proof remain separately truthful rather than blanket logger-only blockers or unsupported success.
